Turn window decisions into prediction intervals

tl_from_windows.Rd

Detectors usually score windows. How a window's decision becomes an interval is an analysis choice that changes the results, so it is made explicit here.

Usage

tl_from_windows(record, detector, decided_at, response, window_start = NULL,
  window_end = NULL, reason = NA_character_, mode = c("hold", "window"),
  max_hold = Inf, until = NULL, gap_response = NULL,
  gap_reason = "no current decision")

Arguments

record,detector

Identifiers (recycled).

decided_at

Time each decision became available.

response

"positive", "negative" or "abstain".

window_start,window_end

Window bounds (needed for mode = "window").

reason

Optional reason for each decision (e.g. why it abstained).

mode

"hold" or "window".

max_hold

Longest time a held decision stays valid.

until

Optional end of each record (recycled over records in order of first appearance, or named by record). The last held decision of a record stays valid until until or for max_hold, whichever comes first; with neither, the last decision has no defined end and is dropped.

gap_response

Optional response for uncovered time between the first and last decision (e.g. "abstain").

gap_reason

Reason stored with gap_response rows.

Details

  • mode = "hold" (real time): a decision issued at decided_at holds from that moment until the next decision of the same record and detector, or for at most max_hold. This uses no future signal.

  • mode = "window" (retrospective): each decision is assigned to its own window \([window_start, window_end)\). Where windows overlap, the window decided last wins. Window ends must increase with window starts.

Time not covered by any decision gets no row; its meaning is then set by the missing argument of tl_ledger(), unless gap_response is given.

Value

A prediction table for tl_ledger() with an issued_at column.

Examples

tl_from_windows("r1", "D", decided_at = c(10, 20, 30),
                response = c("negative", "positive", "negative"),
                max_hold = 15)
#>   record detector start end response reason issued_at
#> 1     r1        D    10  20 negative   <NA>        10
#> 2     r1        D    20  30 positive   <NA>        20
#> 3     r1        D    30  45 negative   <NA>        30
